response.original_title: My Home Is The Rave: The Documentary by Hedex
response.overview: My Home Is The Rave - The Documentary tells the story of Jack Hedges, learn about how it started from working in McDonalds to becoming one of the biggest drum and bass acts in the world, Hedex. See an ever exclusive and private view into three years of his life: the highs, the lows and everything in between on the road to selling out Wembley arena.
